notes.title: SuperJumpWorld Rage Level Editor Update
notes.content:
Did I said that I wouldn't add new content to the level editor? Well yes but actually I found out that I can add new objects to the level editor without older levels to not be updated with newer objects!!!

Here's a list of the new things that will come out so far:

[list]
[*] New Level Editor item: Arrow that is used to tell the player where to go or where something is
[*] New Level Editor item: Wood block, the one in level 8 and 9 that breaks from the middle
[*] New Level Editor item: Small group of knifes from the level 4, 8 and 9 that fall very fast
[*] New Level Editor item: Huge group of knifes from the level 5 and 7 that fall very slowly
[*] New Level Editor adjustement: When saving a loaded level, it's name will be pre-filled
[/list]

This list can change at any moment and idk when the update will come out so don't get too hype.

notes.title: SuperJumpWorld Rage FAQ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43283105/dfb5dccb54d698981eb2f5b208f8bba23df4322d.png[/img]

[i]As my game is out on Steam I assumed that is good to make a little FAQ to inform you about the future of SuperJumpWorld Rage.[/i]


[b]Q : There will be some new content, a second map or even a SuperJumpWorld Rage2?[/b]

A : I don't think, it will add Steam achievements, being more difficult (especially the 25th achievement) and doing a SuperJumpWorld Rage 2 would be to continue the concept and I want all of my games to be unique. This game is an homage to my very first video game, it was a small project who shouldn't have taken this extent and I don't think doing more, it's a chance that he's on Steam.


[b]Q : There will be updates to the game?[/b]

A : As I mentioned above there will be no new content but I'll fix many bugs so I think the game will have many updates.


[b]Q : There will be a 3-4 multiplayer or even online mode?[/b]

A : No, it takes time to add players and the online mode is instable since it not depends on Steam's servers but on servers that could be down at any moment.


[b]Q : There will be new items in the level editor?[/b]

A : I don't think even if I'd like to. Add a new object would be complicated at the implementation of such and such object, for me there's enough to play with.


[b]Q : Is the game has controller support?[/b]

A : It had one but don't work on all controllers, so I had to remove the option.


[b]Q : There will be other languages like spanish for example?[/b]

A : No, it takes time to add one, my native language and english is enough.


[b]Q : Is the game available on other platforms?[/b]

A : Yes, he's on MacOS, HTML5 and Android, available here : http://games.straky.tk/games/JumpWorld/en. (Theses versions has less functionnality)
(Your browser can warn you about the security of the website with a red alert, don't pay attention to it, it's just because of the .tk in his URL which isn't appreciated by Google)


[b]Q : How to contact me?[/b]

A : Through the community hub.


[i]I hope I answer to many questions, and that informed you about the game. My journey on Steam just beggin and I hope to see you again with some new projects :)[/i]

notes.title: Level editor & bug fix update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43283105/5cd81dc4f92482880b68946fd8e0811e029bede1.png[/img]

Fix some bugs in the main game:
[list]
[*] Fix a bug when starting a new game right after quitting a loaded save
[*] Fix a bug that when downloading level, they wouldn't show up in the subscriptions menu
[*] Solo, multiplayer and red/blue color having some issues when selected and starting a new game
[*] Some others minor bugs
[/list]

Improved the level editor:
[list]
[*] Removed the limit of the rock and the knife, you can now place, more than one of them
[*] Remove the UI element of the limitation of some objects that had limitation
[*] If a button and/or 2 doors are placec on the level, their preview in the object selector is now hidden
[*] Being able to save a level while in "play" mode fixed
[*] "Finish a custom level" achievement can now only be unlocked when "play" is clickd in the menu
[/list]

Just to remind you that the knife and maybe the rock too can not function properly when a part of their
hitbox is out of the game's window.

If you encounter any bugs, thanks to tell me about it in the community hub.
